reason: Backfill is_package/itinerary_nights (schema v4) and reclassify NCL SOLO_GUEST_ONLY from availability_status=limited to solo_only. Two defects found 2026-09-15: (1) NCL land+cruise cruisetours were stored unmarked, so price_pppn divided a package fare by cruise-segment nights and read ~2x the true nightly cruise rate; (2) Studio single-occupancy cabins were counted as scarcity, putting 43% of NCL Caribbean inside cells in a depletion bucket containing no depletion. availability_status was re-derived from availability_status_raw, preserved in the original rows. is_package came from scripts/probe_sail_dates.py querying NCL's sailings endpoint on 2026-09-15/16 -- it is a stable product attribute, NOT something observed in the original scrape. No price, sailing, cabin or scrape_ts value was altered; row counts and natural keys are unchanged.
